formal_governance_approval.scope: Frontend Next.js 16.2.9 & Build Toolchain High/Critical Exceptions
formal_governance_approval.remediation_upgrade_plan: Scheduled complete framework upgrade to Next.js 16.4.x / Tailwind v4 stable upon next scheduled release maintenance cycle (Q4 2026). Production runtime isolation in Docker Linux containers ensures client zero-exploitability in current synthetic/pre-production and production staging tiers.

dispositions.justification: Sentinel is deployed strictly on Linux Docker containers (Ubuntu/Alpine). No Windows host execution in production.
dispositions.remediation_plan: Scheduled upgrade to Next.js 16.4.x in next planned maintenance window.
dispositions.approved_by: Vijay Maurya (SBN Platform Owner & Lead Engineer)
